seed: Per Shawn's explicit live direction: rename the reasoning-strategy catalog/package from pmcro-reasoning-strategy to pmcro-omode (his exact words: "it would be pmcro-omode"), and relocate the existing per-Chief plugins/pmcro-csuite/omode/{ceo,cto,...}.yaml trigger tables into select-reasoning-strategy's own skill assets (his words: "wouldn't that be more of a skill assets thing" - confirmed yes, since select-reasoning-strategy/SKILL.md already treats omode/<chief_id>.yaml as its own private input data, not a shared plugin-level concern) to resolve the naming collision between the new pmcro-omode package and the existing per-Chief omode/ directory. Searched the whole repo first (not guessed): ~90 hits across ~45 live files reference reasoning-strategy or omode. Scope: rename the literal package identifier pmcro-reasoning-strategy to pmcro-omode everywhere it is a live reference (directory path, package: frontmatter field, plugin id, cross-plugin invocation syntax pmcro-reasoning-strategy:<skill>); move plugins/pmcro-csuite/omode/*.yaml to plugins/pmcro-csuite/skills/select-reasoning-strategy/assets/*.yaml and update the one relative reference to it in that skill's own SKILL.md. Do NOT rename the select-reasoning-strategy or apply-reasoning-strategy skill names themselves - only the catalog/package identifier, per what was actually asked. Do NOT touch historical/immutable content: .pmcro/trails/** (sealed trail evidence), ADR-*, AUDIT-*, RECONCILIATION-*, PLAN-three-package-architecture.md (these describe what was true at the time and are not live references, per this repo's own Sealed Trail Immutability principle) - only DECLARATIVE-REASONING-STRATEGY-TEMPLATE.md gets updated/renamed since it is this session's own not-yet-historical work describing the very system being renamed.
